title: 36 Hours in Aspen, Colo.
abstract: Even though Aspen regards itself as an international ski playground, the town is still oddly provincial.

title: 36 Hours in Buenos Aires
abstract: This handsome capital is being energized by an influx of tourists, expatriates and returning Argentine émigrés, and its glamorous night life and conspicuous consumption have reached a fever pitch.

title: 36 Hours in Sedona
abstract: Enjoy the quirks this Arizona city has to offer, like a cactus margarita, a church built into the rocks or a spiritual vortex.

title: 36 Hours in Sedona, Ariz.
abstract: Art lovers, shopaholics and pessimists alike will find something to rave about in this quirky city that some call the most beautiful place in the United States.

title: 36 Hours in Mexico City
abstract: A weekend itinerary in a city whose cultural scene is both classic and kitsch.

title: 36 Hours in Mexico City
abstract: Mexico’s capital seems to do no wrong lately, at least when it comes to its cultural exports. A weekend exploring the old and new.

title: 36 Hours in Rio de Janeiro
abstract: Though the city is glued to its sandy shores, Rio has more to offer than its beautiful coastline.

title: 36 Hours in Rio
abstract: A weekend in Rio, where the beaches, bars and caipirinhas are waiting for you.
